parameters.prompt: The exact brown bear warrior in the reference performs ONE ground-heaving strike toward the left. From the resting pose it bends down low and drives both clawed hands into the ground in front of it on the left, gathering strength, then violently straightens and sweeps both arms forward and upward to the left as if flipping the ground over, holds the arms-forward pose briefly, then pulls the arms back, straightens and calmly returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. Both feet stay planted. Keep the exact strict side profile facing LEFT from the reference: head, muzzle, chest and feet point to the left edge, the face never turns toward the camera. Keep the same bear head, rounded ears, brown fur, shoulder armor, bracer, round belt buckle and leather kilt, same proportions. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two arms and two legs. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole body stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. No turning toward the camera, punch, walking, jumping, extra limbs, weapon, glow, energy, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: crouch and dig in over the first second, the heave around one and a half seconds, then recover and hold the original pose.
